name: prize-savings
description: No-loss prize savings on Hedera: deposits stay in the contract and earn native staking rewards, draws schedule themselves with the Hedera Schedule Service, winners come from the PRNG system contract, and deposits are mirrored as non-transferable HTS tickets.

envVars.description: packages/foundry/.env: Foundry keystore used by `foundry:deploy` (create one with `foundry:account:generate`).
packages/foundry/.env (optional): round length for new deployments, default 86400 (one staking-reward period).
packages/nextjs/.env.local (optional): WalletConnect project id for production deployments.

steps.text: The frontend already points at a live PrizePool on Hedera testnet, so you can start the app and deposit right away.

steps.label: Get testnet HBAR for your wallet
Create a deployer keystore and fund its address at the faucet
Deploy a staked PrizePool with the Hedera SDK

steps.text: README.md explains the round lifecycle, the Hedera services involved and every configuration knob.
